232	class CVFDT(AbstractClassifier):
233	    """Concept-adapting Very Fast Decision Tree.
234	
235	    Args:
236	        num_attributes: Number of attributes (optional, inferred otherwise).
237	        num_classes: Number of classes (optional, inferred otherwise).
238	        grace_period: Examples between split attempts at a leaf (``n_min``).
239	        split_confidence: Hoeffding bound confidence ``delta``.
240	        tie_threshold: Forced split threshold ``tau``.
241	        window_size: Size ``w`` of the sliding window of recent examples.
242	        check_frequency: Run ``CheckSplitValidity`` every ``f`` examples.
243	        max_depth: Maximum depth of the tree.
244	        num_bins: Bins used by numeric attribute observers.
245	        max_alternates: Maximum number of alternate subtrees per node.
246	        min_alt_examples: Examples an alternate must see before it can win.
247	        stale_margin: Gain improvement required to declare a split stale.
248	        max_alt_examples: Examples after which a losing alternate is pruned.
249	    """
250	
251	    def __init__(self,
252	                 num_attributes: Optional[int] = None,
253	                 num_classes: Optional[int] = None,
254	                 grace_period: int = 300,
255	                 split_confidence: float = 0.0001,
256	                 tie_threshold: float = 0.05,
257	                 window_size: int = 10000,
258	                 check_frequency: int = 2000,
259	                 max_depth: int = 20,
260	                 num_bins: int = 10,
261	                 max_alternates: int = 1,
262	                 min_alt_examples: int = 1000,
263	                 max_alt_examples: int = 5000,
264	                 stale_margin: float = 0.001,
265	                 nominal_attributes: Optional[Sequence[int]] = None,
266	                 stop_on_pure_leaf: bool = True):
267	        super().__init__()
268	        self.num_attributes = num_attributes if num_attributes else 0
269	        self.num_classes = num_classes if num_classes else 0
270	        self.grace_period = int(grace_period)
271	        self.split_confidence = float(split_confidence)
272	        self.tie_threshold = float(tie_threshold)
273	        self.window_size = int(window_size)
274	        self.check_frequency = int(check_frequency)
275	        self.max_depth = int(max_depth)
276	        self.num_bins = int(num_bins)
277	        self.max_alternates = int(max_alternates)
278	        self.min_alt_examples = int(min_alt_examples)
279	        self.max_alt_examples = int(max_alt_examples)
280	        self.stale_margin = float(stale_margin)
281	        self.nominal_attributes = set(nominal_attributes or ())
282	        self.stop_on_pure_leaf = bool(stop_on_pure_leaf)
283	
284	        #: FIFO window of ``(instance, touched_nodes)`` pairs
285	        self.window: Deque[Tuple[Instance, List[HoeffdingTreeNode]]] = deque(
286	            maxlen=self.window_size)
287	        #: class distribution of the examples currently inside the window
288	        self.window_class_counts: Dict[int, float] = {}
289	
290	        self.num_splits_performed = 0
291	        self.num_alternates_started = 0
292	        self.num_alternates_promoted = 0
293	        self.num_alternates_pruned = 0
294	        self.num_split_checks = 0
295	
296	        self.root: HoeffdingTreeNode = self._new_leaf(depth=0)
297	
298	    # -- factories ---------------------------------------------------------
299	    def new_attribute_observer(self, attr_index: int) -> AttributeObserver:
300	        if attr_index in self.nominal_attributes:
301	            return NominalAttributeObserver()
302	        return NumericAttributeObserver(num_bins=self.num_bins)
303	
304	    def _new_leaf(self, depth: int = 0,
305	                  class_counts: Optional[Dict[int, float]] = None) -> CVFDTLeaf:
306	        return CVFDTLeaf(depth=depth, class_counts=class_counts, tree=self)
307	
308	    def _new_split_node(self, suggestion: SplitSuggestion,
309	                        depth: int) -> CVFDTSplit:
310	        # Statistics start empty so that every count stored in the tree always
311	        # corresponds to an example that is still inside the sliding window.
312	        return CVFDTSplit(suggestion.attribute_index, suggestion.split_value,
313	                          depth=depth, num_branches=suggestion.num_branches,
314	                          is_nominal=suggestion.is_nominal,
315	                          branch_values=suggestion.branch_values, tree=self)
316	
317	    # -- bookkeeping -------------------------------------------------------
318	    def _observe_instance_meta(self, instance: Instance):
319	        if instance.num_attributes > self.num_attributes:
320	            self.num_attributes = instance.num_attributes
321	        if instance.label is not None and instance.label + 1 > self.num_classes:
322	            self.num_classes = instance.label + 1
323	
324	    # -- training ----------------------------------------------------------
325	    def train(self, instance: Instance):
326	        """Train on one example: window maintenance, growth, periodic checks."""
327	        self._observe_instance_meta(instance)
328	        self.instances_seen += 1
329	
330	        # 1. make room in the window, forgetting the oldest example
331	        if len(self.window) >= self.window_size:
332	            old_instance, old_nodes = self.window.popleft()
333	            self._forget_instance(old_instance, old_nodes)
334	
335	        # 2. register the example first: the list of touched nodes is shared
336	        #    with the window so that a split happening while this very example
337	        #    is being learnt also updates its path.
338	        touched: List[HoeffdingTreeNode] = []
339	        self.window.append((instance, touched))
340	        label = instance.label
341	        self.window_class_counts[label] = self.window_class_counts.get(label, 0.0) + 1.0
342	
343	        # 3. grow the main tree (and every alternate on the path)
344	        self._learn_instance(instance, touched)
345	
346	        # 4. every ``check_frequency`` examples revisit the split decisions
347	        if self.check_frequency > 0 and self.instances_seen % self.check_frequency == 0:
348	            self.check_split_validity()
349	
350	    def partial_fit(self, instance: Instance):
351	        """Alias for :meth:`train`."""
352	        self.train(instance)
353	
354	    # -- forgetting --------------------------------------------------------
355	    def _forget_instance(self, instance: Instance,
356	                         nodes: Sequence[HoeffdingTreeNode]):
357	        label = instance.label
358	        remaining = self.window_class_counts.get(label, 0.0) - 1.0
359	        if remaining > 0.0:
360	            self.window_class_counts[label] = remaining
361	        else:
362	            self.window_class_counts.pop(label, None)
363	        for node in nodes:
364	            if node.alive:
365	                node.forget(instance)
366	
367	    # -- growth ------------------------------------------------------------
368	    def _learn_instance(self, instance: Instance,
369	                        touched: Optional[List[HoeffdingTreeNode]] = None
370	                        ) -> List[HoeffdingTreeNode]:
371	        """Update the main tree and all reachable alternates.
372	
373	        Returns the list of nodes whose statistics were updated so that the
374	        example can be forgotten later on.
375	        """
376	        if touched is None:
377	            touched = []
378	        self._learn_subtree(self.root, instance, touched, owner=None,
379	                            owner_branch=-1, alt_owner=None, alt_index=-1,
380	                            allow_alternates=True)
381	        return touched
382	
383	    def _learn_subtree(self, root: HoeffdingTreeNode, instance: Instance,
384	                       touched: List[HoeffdingTreeNode],
385	                       owner: Optional[CVFDTSplit], owner_branch: int,
386	                       alt_owner: Optional[CVFDTSplit], alt_index: int,
387	                       allow_alternates: bool):
388	        """Route ``instance`` through one (sub)tree, learning on the way.
389	
390	        ``owner``/``owner_branch`` identify where ``root`` hangs in the main
391	        tree, ``alt_owner``/``alt_index`` identify it as an alternate subtree.
392	        Exactly one of the two is used to re-attach a new root after a split.
393	        """
394	        node = root
395	        parent: Optional[HoeffdingTreeSplit] = None
396	        parent_branch = -1
397	        while True:
398	            touched.append(node)
399	            if node.is_leaf():
400	                leaf = node  # type: CVFDTLeaf
401	                leaf.learn_from_instance(instance, self)
402	                if leaf.should_attempt_split(self.grace_period):
403	                    leaf.reset_split_attempt_counter()
404	                    if not (self.stop_on_pure_leaf
405	                            and leaf.observed_class_distribution_is_pure()):
406	                        new_node = self.attempt_to_split(leaf, parent, parent_branch)
407	                        if new_node is not None and parent is None:
408	                            self._reattach_root(new_node, owner, owner_branch,
409	                                                alt_owner, alt_index)
410	                return
411	
412	            split = node  # type: CVFDTSplit
413	            split.learn_from_instance(instance, self)
414	            if allow_alternates and split.alternate_trees:
415	                self._train_alternates(split, instance, touched)
416	
417	            branch = split.branch_for_instance(instance)
418	            child = split.get_child(branch)
419	            if child is None:
420	                child = self._new_leaf(depth=split.depth + 1)
421	                split.set_child(branch, child)
422	            parent = split
423	            parent_branch = branch
424	            node = child
425	
426	    def _reattach_root(self, new_root: HoeffdingTreeNode,
427	                       owner: Optional[CVFDTSplit], owner_branch: int,
428	                       alt_owner: Optional[CVFDTSplit], alt_index: int):
429	        """Install ``new_root`` where the previous subtree root was hanging."""
430	        if alt_owner is not None and 0 <= alt_index < len(alt_owner.alternate_trees):
431	            alt_owner.alternate_trees[alt_index] = new_root
432	        elif owner is not None:
433	            owner.set_child(owner_branch, new_root)
434	        else:
435	            self.root = new_root
436	
437	    def _train_alternates(self, split: CVFDTSplit, instance: Instance,
438	                          touched: List[HoeffdingTreeNode]):
439	        """Grow every alternate of ``split`` and score it against the main."""
440	        label = instance.label
441	        main_pred = self._subtree_predict(split, instance)
442	        split.main_seen += 1.0
443	        if main_pred == label:
444	            split.main_correct += 1.0
445	        for index in range(len(split.alternate_trees)):
446	            alt_root = split.alternate_trees[index]
447	            alt_pred = self._subtree_predict(alt_root, instance)
448	            split.alt_seen[index] += 1.0
449	            if alt_pred == label:
450	                split.alt_correct[index] += 1.0
451	            # alternates never spawn alternates of their own
452	            self._learn_subtree(alt_root, instance, touched, owner=None,
453	                                owner_branch=-1, alt_owner=split,
454	                                alt_index=index, allow_alternates=False)
455	
456	    def attempt_to_split(self, leaf: CVFDTLeaf,
457	                         parent: Optional[HoeffdingTreeSplit],
458	                         parent_branch: int) -> Optional[HoeffdingTreeSplit]:
459	        """Try to turn ``leaf`` into a split node; return the new node or None."""
460	        if leaf.depth >= self.max_depth:
461	            return None
462	        suggestions = compute_split_suggestions(leaf, self.num_classes)
463	        chosen, _epsilon = select_split_suggestion(
464	            suggestions, self.num_classes, leaf.weight_seen,
465	            self.split_confidence, self.tie_threshold)
466	        if chosen is None:
467	            return None
468	
469	        split_node = self._new_split_node(chosen, depth=leaf.depth)
470	        num_branches = max(2, len(chosen.post_split_dists))
471	        for branch in range(num_branches):
472	            split_node.set_child(branch, self._new_leaf(depth=leaf.depth + 1))
473	        leaf.alive = False
474	        if parent is not None:
475	            parent.set_child(parent_branch, split_node)
476	        self.num_splits_performed += 1
477	        # Re-play the window examples that belonged to ``leaf`` so that the new
478	        # subtree carries exactly the statistics of the current window.
479	        self._reseed_after_split(leaf, split_node)
480	        return split_node

482	    def _reseed_after_split(self, leaf: CVFDTLeaf, split_node: CVFDTSplit):
483	        """Move ``leaf``'s window examples into the freshly created subtree."""
484	        for _instance, nodes in self.window:
485	            for position, node in enumerate(nodes):
486	                if node is leaf:
487	                    branch = split_node.branch_for_instance(_instance)
488	                    child = split_node.get_child(branch)
489	                    if child is None:
490	                        child = self._new_leaf(depth=split_node.depth + 1)
491	                        split_node.set_child(branch, child)
492	                    split_node.learn_from_instance(_instance, self)
493	                    child.learn_from_instance(_instance, self)
494	                    nodes[position] = split_node
495	                    nodes.append(child)
496	                    break
497	        # the replayed examples must not immediately trigger another split
498	        for child in split_node.children_nodes():
499	            if child.is_leaf():
500	                child.reset_split_attempt_counter()  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
501	
502	    def _seed_alternate(self, split: CVFDTSplit, alternate: CVFDTLeaf):
503	        """Give a new alternate the window statistics of the node it shadows."""
504	        for _instance, nodes in self.window:
505	            for node in nodes:
506	                if node is split:
507	                    alternate.learn_from_instance(_instance, self)
508	                    nodes.append(alternate)
509	                    break

512	    # -- CheckSplitValidity ------------------------------------------------
513	    def check_split_validity(self):
514	        """Re-examine every split, start alternates and promote/prune them."""
515	        self.num_split_checks += 1
516	        stack: List[Tuple[HoeffdingTreeNode, Optional[CVFDTSplit], int]] = [
517	            (self.root, None, -1)]
518	        while stack:
519	            node, parent, branch = stack.pop()
520	            if node.is_leaf():
521	                continue
522	            split = node  # type: CVFDTSplit
523	            replaced = self._test_alternates(split, parent, branch)
524	            if replaced is not None:
525	                # the alternate took over: revisit the promoted subtree later
526	                stack.append((replaced, parent, branch))
527	                continue
528	            self._check_node_split(split)
529	            for child_branch, child in enumerate(split.children):
530	                if child is not None:
531	                    stack.append((child, split, child_branch))

533	    def _check_node_split(self, split: CVFDTSplit):
534	        """Start an alternate when the current split decision is stale.
535	
536	        The split of a node is stale when some other candidate split of the
537	        window statistics is better than the split currently installed, by more
538	        than the Hoeffding bound (capped by the tie threshold).  This covers
539	        both a change of the best *attribute* (the case discussed in the CVFDT
540	        paper for nominal attributes) and a drifting *threshold* on the very
541	        same numeric attribute.
542	        """
543	        if len(split.alternate_trees) >= self.max_alternates:
544	            return
545	        if split.weight_seen < self.grace_period:
546	            return
547	        suggestions = compute_split_suggestions(split, self.num_classes)
548	        if not suggestions:
549	            return
550	        best = suggestions[-1]
551	        if best.merit <= 0.0:
552	            return
553	
554	        observer = split.attribute_observers.get(split.split_attribute)
555	        if observer is None:
556	            return
557	        current_gain = gain_of_existing_split(observer, self.num_classes,
558	                                              split.split_value)
559	        range_val = math.log2(max(2, self.num_classes))
560	        epsilon = compute_hoeffding_bound(range_val, self.split_confidence,
561	                                          split.weight_seen)
562	        # Mirror the VFDT tie rule: while the bound is loose the improvement has
563	        # to beat it, once enough examples support the estimate (epsilon below
564	        # the tie threshold) any material improvement is trusted.
565	        required = epsilon if epsilon >= self.tie_threshold else self.stale_margin
566	        if (best.merit - current_gain) <= required:
567	            return
568	
569	        # the installed split is no longer the best one -> grow an alternate
570	        alternate = self._new_leaf(depth=split.depth)
571	        split.add_alternate(alternate)
572	        self._seed_alternate(split, alternate)
573	        split.main_correct = 0.0
574	        split.main_seen = 0.0
575	        self.num_alternates_started += 1
576	
577	    def _test_alternates(self, split: CVFDTSplit,
578	                         parent: Optional[CVFDTSplit],
579	                         parent_branch: int) -> Optional[HoeffdingTreeNode]:
580	        """Promote a winning alternate, prune hopeless ones.
581	
582	        Returns the promoted subtree root when a replacement happened.
583	        """
584	        if not split.alternate_trees:
585	            return None
586	        main_seen = split.main_seen
587	        main_acc = (split.main_correct / main_seen) if main_seen > 0 else 0.0
588	        best_index = -1
589	        best_acc = main_acc
590	        for index in range(len(split.alternate_trees)):
591	            seen = split.alt_seen[index]
592	            if seen < self.min_alt_examples:
593	                continue
594	            acc = split.alt_correct[index] / seen
595	            if acc > best_acc:
596	                best_acc = acc
597	                best_index = index
598	        if best_index >= 0:
599	            return self._promote_alternate(split, best_index, parent,
600	                                           parent_branch)
601	        # prune alternates that had enough time and still lose
602	        for index in range(len(split.alternate_trees) - 1, -1, -1):
603	            if split.alt_seen[index] >= self.max_alt_examples:
604	                dropped = split.drop_alternate(index)
605	                if dropped is not None:
606	                    self._mark_dead(dropped)
607	                    self.num_alternates_pruned += 1
608	        return None
609	
610	    def _promote_alternate(self, split: CVFDTSplit, index: int,
611	                           parent: Optional[CVFDTSplit],
612	                           parent_branch: int) -> HoeffdingTreeNode:
613	        """Replace ``split``'s subtree by its ``index``-th alternate."""
614	        alternate = split.drop_alternate(index)
615	        assert alternate is not None
616	        self._mark_dead(split)          # kills the old subtree + other alternates
617	        alternate.alive = True
618	        self._refresh_depths(alternate, split.depth)
619	        if parent is None:
620	            self.root = alternate
621	        else:
622	            parent.set_child(parent_branch, alternate)
623	        self.num_alternates_promoted += 1
624	        return alternate

626	    def _mark_dead(self, node: HoeffdingTreeNode):
627	        stack = [node]
628	        while stack:
629	            current = stack.pop()
630	            current.alive = False
631	            for child in current.children_nodes():
632	                stack.append(child)
633	            for alt in getattr(current, "alternate_trees", ()):  # type: ignore[arg-type]
634	                stack.append(alt)
635	
636	    def _refresh_depths(self, node: HoeffdingTreeNode, depth: int):
637	        stack = [(node, depth)]
638	        while stack:
639	            current, current_depth = stack.pop()
640	            current.depth = current_depth
641	            current.alive = True
642	            for child in current.children_nodes():
643	                stack.append((child, current_depth + 1))
644	            for alt in getattr(current, "alternate_trees", ()):  # type: ignore[arg-type]
645	                stack.append((alt, current_depth))

654	        best_weight = float("-inf")
655	        for cls in sorted(votes):
656	            weight = votes[cls]
657	            if weight > best_weight:
658	                best_weight = weight
659	                best_class = cls

667	            child = node.get_child(branch)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]

674	        if not self.window_class_counts:

695	        if not votes:
696	            return 0

698	        best_weight = float("-inf")
699	        for cls in sorted(votes):
700	            weight = votes[cls]
701	            if weight > best_weight:
702	                best_weight = weight
703	                best_class = cls
704	        return best_class if best_class >= 0 else 0

"""CVFDT: Concept-adapting Very Fast Decision Tree.

Implementation of the time-changing stream learner of Hulten, Spencer &
Domingos, "Mining Time-Changing Data Streams", KDD 2001.

CVFDT keeps the VFDT growth procedure but adds the machinery needed to track
a moving concept:

* a FIFO window ``W`` of the ``w`` most recent examples.  When an example
  leaves the window its contribution is *forgotten*, i.e. subtracted from the
  sufficient statistics of every node it updated when it arrived;
* internal (split) nodes keep sufficient statistics as well, so the tree can
  periodically ask whether the attribute it split on is still the best one
  (``CheckSplitValidity``);
* whenever the current split is no longer the best choice an *alternate*
  subtree is grown in the background.  Alternates learn from the same stream
  and are periodically compared against the subtree they shadow; a more
  accurate alternate replaces it, a hopeless one is pruned.
"""

from collections import deque
import math
from typing import Deque, Dict, List, Optional, Sequence, Tuple

from attribute_observers import (AttributeObserver, NominalAttributeObserver,
                                 NumericAttributeObserver)
from classifiers import AbstractClassifier, compute_hoeffding_bound
from hoeffding_tree import (HoeffdingTree, HoeffdingTreeLeaf, HoeffdingTreeNode,
                            HoeffdingTreeSplit, SplitSuggestion,
                            compute_split_suggestions, select_split_suggestion)
from streams import Instance

__all__ = [
    "CVFDTLeaf",
    "CVFDTSplit",
    "CVFDT",
    "gain_of_existing_split",
    "run_cvfdt_experiments",
]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# statistics helpers shared by leaves and internal nodes
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _learn_stats(node, instance: Instance, tree: Optional["CVFDT"],
                 weight: float = 1.0):
    """Add ``instance`` to the sufficient statistics held by ``node``."""
    label = instance.label
    node.class_counts[label] = node.class_counts.get(label, 0.0) + weight
    node.weight_seen += weight
    observers = node.attribute_observers
    for attr_index, value in enumerate(instance.features):
        observer = observers.get(attr_index)
        if observer is None:
            if tree is not None:
                observer = tree.new_attribute_observer(attr_index)
            else:
                observer = NumericAttributeObserver()
            observers[attr_index] = observer
        observer.observe(value, label, weight)


def _forget_stats(node, instance: Instance, weight: float = 1.0):
    """Subtract ``instance`` from the sufficient statistics held by ``node``."""
    label = instance.label
    remaining = node.class_counts.get(label, 0.0) - weight
    if remaining > 0.0:
        node.class_counts[label] = remaining
    else:
        node.class_counts.pop(label, None)
    node.weight_seen = max(0.0, node.weight_seen - weight)
    observers = node.attribute_observers
    if not observers:
        return
    for attr_index, value in enumerate(instance.features):
        observer = observers.get(attr_index)
        if observer is not None:
            # negative weight decrements the stored counts
            observer.observe(value, label, -weight)


def gain_of_existing_split(observer: AttributeObserver, num_classes: int,
                           split_value: float) -> float:
    """Information gain the *current* split of a node would have today.

    The candidate cut points of a :class:`NumericAttributeObserver` are the
    ``num_bins - 1`` bin boundaries; the gain of the existing split is the gain
    of the cut point closest to ``split_value``, recomputed from the statistics
    of the examples that are currently inside the sliding window.
    """
    from classifiers import compute_info_gain

    if isinstance(observer, NominalAttributeObserver):
        gain, _value, _dists = observer.get_best_split_suggestion(num_classes)
        return gain
    if not isinstance(observer, NumericAttributeObserver):
        return 0.0
    if observer.total_count <= 0 or observer.max_val <= observer.min_val:
        return 0.0

    n_classes = max(2, num_classes)
    pre_counts = [0.0] * n_classes
    for cls, count in observer.total_per_class.items():
        if cls < n_classes:
            pre_counts[cls] = count

    span = observer.max_val - observer.min_val
    left_counts = [0.0] * n_classes
    best_distance = float("inf")
    gain_at_split = 0.0
    for i in range(observer.num_bins - 1):
        for cls, count in observer.bin_counts[i].items():
            if cls < n_classes:
                left_counts[cls] += count
        cut_point = observer.min_val + (i + 1) * span / observer.num_bins
        distance = abs(cut_point - split_value)
        if distance > best_distance:
            break
        right_counts = [pre_counts[c] - left_counts[c] for c in range(n_classes)]
        if sum(left_counts) > 0 and sum(right_counts) > 0:
            best_distance = distance
            gain_at_split = compute_info_gain(pre_counts,
                                              [left_counts[:], right_counts])
        else:
            best_distance = distance
            gain_at_split = 0.0
    return gain_at_split


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# nodes
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


class CVFDTLeaf(HoeffdingTreeLeaf):
    """A learning leaf that can also *forget* examples leaving the window."""

    def __init__(self, depth: int = 0,
                 class_counts: Optional[Dict[int, float]] = None,
                 tree: Optional["CVFDT"] = None):
        super().__init__(depth=depth, class_counts=class_counts, tree=tree)
        # Examples seen since the last split attempt.  This counter only ever
        # grows (forgetting does not cancel split attempts), which is what the
        # CVFDT pseudo code means by "the number of examples seen at l".
        self.examples_since_split_attempt: float = 0.0

    def learn_from_instance(self, instance: Instance, tree=None,
                            weight: float = 1.0):
        if tree is not None:
            self._tree = tree
        _learn_stats(self, instance, self._tree, weight)
        self.examples_since_split_attempt += weight

    def forget(self, instance: Instance, weight: float = 1.0):
        """Undo the effect of ``instance`` on this leaf."""
        _forget_stats(self, instance, weight)
        if self.weight_seen_at_last_split_attempt > self.weight_seen:
            self.weight_seen_at_last_split_attempt = self.weight_seen

    def reset_split_attempt_counter(self):
        self.weight_seen_at_last_split_attempt = self.weight_seen
        self.examples_since_split_attempt = 0.0

    def should_attempt_split(self, grace_period: float) -> bool:
        return self.examples_since_split_attempt >= grace_period


class CVFDTSplit(HoeffdingTreeSplit):
    """Internal node that keeps statistics and can host alternate subtrees."""

    def __init__(self, split_attribute: int, split_value: float, depth: int = 0,
                 class_counts: Optional[Dict[int, float]] = None,
                 num_branches: int = 2, is_nominal: bool = False,
                 branch_values: Optional[Sequence[int]] = None,
                 tree: Optional["CVFDT"] = None):
        super().__init__(split_attribute, split_value, depth=depth,
                         class_counts=class_counts, num_branches=num_branches,
                         is_nominal=is_nominal, branch_values=branch_values)
        #: alternate subtrees grown in the background for this node
        self.alternate_trees: List[HoeffdingTreeNode] = []
        self.attribute_observers: Dict[int, AttributeObserver] = {}
        self.weight_seen: float = float(sum(self.class_counts.values()))
        self.weight_seen_at_last_split_check: float = 0.0
        self._tree = tree
        # accuracy bookkeeping used when comparing against the alternates
        self.main_correct: float = 0.0
        self.main_seen: float = 0.0
        self.alt_correct: List[float] = []
        self.alt_seen: List[float] = []

    # -- statistics --------------------------------------------------------
    def learn_from_instance(self, instance: Instance, tree=None,
                            weight: float = 1.0):
        if tree is not None:
            self._tree = tree
        _learn_stats(self, instance, self._tree, weight)

    def forget(self, instance: Instance, weight: float = 1.0):
        _forget_stats(self, instance, weight)

    # -- alternates --------------------------------------------------------
    def add_alternate(self, root: HoeffdingTreeNode):
        self.alternate_trees.append(root)
        self.alt_correct.append(0.0)
        self.alt_seen.append(0.0)

    def drop_alternate(self, index: int) -> Optional[HoeffdingTreeNode]:
        if 0 <= index < len(self.alternate_trees):
            root = self.alternate_trees.pop(index)
            self.alt_correct.pop(index)
            self.alt_seen.pop(index)
            return root
        return None

    def reset_accuracy_counters(self):
        self.main_correct = 0.0
        self.main_seen = 0.0
        self.alt_correct = [0.0] * len(self.alternate_trees)
        self.alt_seen = [0.0] * len(self.alternate_trees)

    def num_alternate_nodes(self) -> int:
        return sum(root.num_nodes() for root in self.alternate_trees)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# the learner
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


class CVFDT(AbstractClassifier):
    """Concept-adapting Very Fast Decision Tree.

    Args:
        num_attributes: Number of attributes (optional, inferred otherwise).
        num_classes: Number of classes (optional, inferred otherwise).
        grace_period: Examples between split attempts at a leaf (``n_min``).
        split_confidence: Hoeffding bound confidence ``delta``.
        tie_threshold: Forced split threshold ``tau``.
        window_size: Size ``w`` of the sliding window of recent examples.
        check_frequency: Run ``CheckSplitValidity`` every ``f`` examples.
        max_depth: Maximum depth of the tree.
        num_bins: Bins used by numeric attribute observers.
        max_alternates: Maximum number of alternate subtrees per node.
        min_alt_examples: Examples an alternate must see before it can win.
        stale_margin: Gain improvement required to declare a split stale.
        max_alt_examples: Examples after which a losing alternate is pruned.
    """

    def __init__(self,
                 num_attributes: Optional[int] = None,
                 num_classes: Optional[int] = None,
                 grace_period: int = 300,
                 split_confidence: float = 0.0001,
                 tie_threshold: float = 0.05,
                 window_size: int = 10000,
                 check_frequency: int = 2000,
                 max_depth: int = 20,
                 num_bins: int = 10,
                 max_alternates: int = 1,
                 min_alt_examples: int = 1000,
                 max_alt_examples: int = 5000,
                 stale_margin: float = 0.001,
                 nominal_attributes: Optional[Sequence[int]] = None,
                 stop_on_pure_leaf: bool = True):
        super().__init__()
        self.num_attributes = num_attributes if num_attributes else 0
        self.num_classes = num_classes if num_classes else 0
        self.grace_period = int(grace_period)
        self.split_confidence = float(split_confidence)
        self.tie_threshold = float(tie_threshold)
        self.window_size = int(window_size)
        self.check_frequency = int(check_frequency)
        self.max_depth = int(max_depth)
        self.num_bins = int(num_bins)
        self.max_alternates = int(max_alternates)
        self.min_alt_examples = int(min_alt_examples)
        self.max_alt_examples = int(max_alt_examples)
        self.stale_margin = float(stale_margin)
        self.nominal_attributes = set(nominal_attributes or ())
        self.stop_on_pure_leaf = bool(stop_on_pure_leaf)

        #: FIFO window of ``(instance, touched_nodes)`` pairs
        self.window: Deque[Tuple[Instance, List[HoeffdingTreeNode]]] = deque(
            maxlen=self.window_size)
        #: class distribution of the examples currently inside the window
        self.window_class_counts: Dict[int, float] = {}

        self.num_splits_performed = 0
        self.num_alternates_started = 0
        self.num_alternates_promoted = 0
        self.num_alternates_pruned = 0
        self.num_split_checks = 0

        self.root: HoeffdingTreeNode = self._new_leaf(depth=0)

    # -- factories ---------------------------------------------------------
    def new_attribute_observer(self, attr_index: int) -> AttributeObserver:
        if attr_index in self.nominal_attributes:
            return NominalAttributeObserver()
        return NumericAttributeObserver(num_bins=self.num_bins)

    def _new_leaf(self, depth: int = 0,
                  class_counts: Optional[Dict[int, float]] = None) -> CVFDTLeaf:
        return CVFDTLeaf(depth=depth, class_counts=class_counts, tree=self)

    def _new_split_node(self, suggestion: SplitSuggestion,
                        depth: int) -> CVFDTSplit:
        # Statistics start empty so that every count stored in the tree always
        # corresponds to an example that is still inside the sliding window.
        return CVFDTSplit(suggestion.attribute_index, suggestion.split_value,
                          depth=depth, num_branches=suggestion.num_branches,
                          is_nominal=suggestion.is_nominal,
                          branch_values=suggestion.branch_values, tree=self)

    # -- bookkeeping -------------------------------------------------------
    def _observe_instance_meta(self, instance: Instance):
        if instance.num_attributes > self.num_attributes:
            self.num_attributes = instance.num_attributes
        if instance.label is not None and instance.label + 1 > self.num_classes:
            self.num_classes = instance.label + 1

    # -- training ----------------------------------------------------------
    def train(self, instance: Instance):
        """Train on one example: window maintenance, growth, periodic checks."""
        self._observe_instance_meta(instance)
        self.instances_seen += 1

        # 1. make room in the window, forgetting the oldest example
        if len(self.window) >= self.window_size:
            old_instance, old_nodes = self.window.popleft()
            self._forget_instance(old_instance, old_nodes)

        # 2. register the example first: the list of touched nodes is shared
        #    with the window so that a split happening while this very example
        #    is being learnt also updates its path.
        touched: List[HoeffdingTreeNode] = []
        self.window.append((instance, touched))
        label = instance.label
        self.window_class_counts[label] = self.window_class_counts.get(label, 0.0) + 1.0

        # 3. grow the main tree (and every alternate on the path)
        self._learn_instance(instance, touched)

        # 4. every ``check_frequency`` examples revisit the split decisions
        if self.check_frequency > 0 and self.instances_seen % self.check_frequency == 0:
            self.check_split_validity()

    def partial_fit(self, instance: Instance):
        """Alias for :meth:`train`."""
        self.train(instance)

    # -- forgetting --------------------------------------------------------
    def _forget_instance(self, instance: Instance,
                         nodes: Sequence[HoeffdingTreeNode]):
        label = instance.label
        remaining = self.window_class_counts.get(label, 0.0) - 1.0
        if remaining > 0.0:
            self.window_class_counts[label] = remaining
        else:
            self.window_class_counts.pop(label, None)
        for node in nodes:
            if node.alive:
                node.forget(instance)

    # -- growth ------------------------------------------------------------
    def _learn_instance(self, instance: Instance,
                        touched: Optional[List[HoeffdingTreeNode]] = None
                        ) -> List[HoeffdingTreeNode]:
        """Update the main tree and all reachable alternates.

        Returns the list of nodes whose statistics were updated so that the
        example can be forgotten later on.
        """
        if touched is None:
            touched = []
        self._learn_subtree(self.root, instance, touched, owner=None,
                            owner_branch=-1, alt_owner=None, alt_index=-1,
                            allow_alternates=True)
        return touched

    def _learn_subtree(self, root: HoeffdingTreeNode, instance: Instance,
                       touched: List[HoeffdingTreeNode],
                       owner: Optional[CVFDTSplit], owner_branch: int,
                       alt_owner: Optional[CVFDTSplit], alt_index: int,
                       allow_alternates: bool):
        """Route ``instance`` through one (sub)tree, learning on the way.

        ``owner``/``owner_branch`` identify where ``root`` hangs in the main
        tree, ``alt_owner``/``alt_index`` identify it as an alternate subtree.
        Exactly one of the two is used to re-attach a new root after a split.
        """
        node = root
        parent: Optional[HoeffdingTreeSplit] = None
        parent_branch = -1
        while True:
            touched.append(node)
            if node.is_leaf():
                leaf = node  # type: CVFDTLeaf
                leaf.learn_from_instance(instance, self)
                if leaf.should_attempt_split(self.grace_period):
                    leaf.reset_split_attempt_counter()
                    if not (self.stop_on_pure_leaf
                            and leaf.observed_class_distribution_is_pure()):
                        new_node = self.attempt_to_split(leaf, parent, parent_branch)
                        if new_node is not None and parent is None:
                            self._reattach_root(new_node, owner, owner_branch,
                                                alt_owner, alt_index)
                return

            split = node  # type: CVFDTSplit
            split.learn_from_instance(instance, self)
            if allow_alternates and split.alternate_trees:
                self._train_alternates(split, instance, touched)

            branch = split.branch_for_instance(instance)
            child = split.get_child(branch)
            if child is None:
                child = self._new_leaf(depth=split.depth + 1)
                split.set_child(branch, child)
            parent = split
            parent_branch = branch
            node = child

    def _reattach_root(self, new_root: HoeffdingTreeNode,
                       owner: Optional[CVFDTSplit], owner_branch: int,
                       alt_owner: Optional[CVFDTSplit], alt_index: int):
        """Install ``new_root`` where the previous subtree root was hanging."""
        if alt_owner is not None and 0 <= alt_index < len(alt_owner.alternate_trees):
            alt_owner.alternate_trees[alt_index] = new_root
        elif owner is not None:
            owner.set_child(owner_branch, new_root)
        else:
            self.root = new_root

    def _train_alternates(self, split: CVFDTSplit, instance: Instance,
                          touched: List[HoeffdingTreeNode]):
        """Grow every alternate of ``split`` and score it against the main."""
        label = instance.label
        main_pred = self._subtree_predict(split, instance)
        split.main_seen += 1.0
        if main_pred == label:
            split.main_correct += 1.0
        for index in range(len(split.alternate_trees)):
            alt_root = split.alternate_trees[index]
            alt_pred = self._subtree_predict(alt_root, instance)
            split.alt_seen[index] += 1.0
            if alt_pred == label:
                split.alt_correct[index] += 1.0
            # alternates never spawn alternates of their own
            self._learn_subtree(alt_root, instance, touched, owner=None,
                                owner_branch=-1, alt_owner=split,
                                alt_index=index, allow_alternates=False)

    def attempt_to_split(self, leaf: CVFDTLeaf,
                         parent: Optional[HoeffdingTreeSplit],
                         parent_branch: int) -> Optional[HoeffdingTreeSplit]:
        """Try to turn ``leaf`` into a split node; return the new node or None."""
        if leaf.depth >= self.max_depth:
            return None
        suggestions = compute_split_suggestions(leaf, self.num_classes)
        chosen, _epsilon = select_split_suggestion(
            suggestions, self.num_classes, leaf.weight_seen,
            self.split_confidence, self.tie_threshold)
        if chosen is None:
            return None

        split_node = self._new_split_node(chosen, depth=leaf.depth)
        num_branches = max(2, len(chosen.post_split_dists))
        for branch in range(num_branches):
            split_node.set_child(branch, self._new_leaf(depth=leaf.depth + 1))
        leaf.alive = False
        if parent is not None:
            parent.set_child(parent_branch, split_node)
        self.num_splits_performed += 1
        # Re-play the window examples that belonged to ``leaf`` so that the new
        # subtree carries exactly the statistics of the current window.
        self._reseed_after_split(leaf, split_node)
        return split_node

    def _reseed_after_split(self, leaf: CVFDTLeaf, split_node: CVFDTSplit):
        """Move ``leaf``'s window examples into the freshly created subtree."""
        for _instance, nodes in self.window:
            for position, node in enumerate(nodes):
                if node is leaf:
                    branch = split_node.branch_for_instance(_instance)
                    child = split_node.get_child(branch)
                    if child is None:
                        child = self._new_leaf(depth=split_node.depth + 1)
                        split_node.set_child(branch, child)
                    split_node.learn_from_instance(_instance, self)
                    child.learn_from_instance(_instance, self)
                    nodes[position] = split_node
                    nodes.append(child)
                    break
        # the replayed examples must not immediately trigger another split
        for child in split_node.children_nodes():
            if child.is_leaf():
                child.reset_split_attempt_counter()  # type: ignore[attr-defined]

    def _seed_alternate(self, split: CVFDTSplit, alternate: CVFDTLeaf):
        """Give a new alternate the window statistics of the node it shadows."""
        for _instance, nodes in self.window:
            for node in nodes:
                if node is split:
                    alternate.learn_from_instance(_instance, self)
                    nodes.append(alternate)
                    break
        alternate.reset_split_attempt_counter()

    # -- CheckSplitValidity ------------------------------------------------
    def check_split_validity(self):
        """Re-examine every split, start alternates and promote/prune them."""
        self.num_split_checks += 1
        stack: List[Tuple[HoeffdingTreeNode, Optional[CVFDTSplit], int]] = [
            (self.root, None, -1)]
        while stack:
            node, parent, branch = stack.pop()
            if node.is_leaf():
                continue
            split = node  # type: CVFDTSplit
            replaced = self._test_alternates(split, parent, branch)
            if replaced is not None:
                # the alternate took over: revisit the promoted subtree later
                stack.append((replaced, parent, branch))
                continue
            self._check_node_split(split)
            for child_branch, child in enumerate(split.children):
                if child is not None:
                    stack.append((child, split, child_branch))

    def _check_node_split(self, split: CVFDTSplit):
        """Start an alternate when the current split decision is stale.

        The split of a node is stale when some other candidate split of the
        window statistics is better than the split currently installed, by more
        than the Hoeffding bound (capped by the tie threshold).  This covers
        both a change of the best *attribute* (the case discussed in the CVFDT
        paper for nominal attributes) and a drifting *threshold* on the very
        same numeric attribute.
        """
        if len(split.alternate_trees) >= self.max_alternates:
            return
        if split.weight_seen < self.grace_period:
            return
        suggestions = compute_split_suggestions(split, self.num_classes)
        if not suggestions:
            return
        best = suggestions[-1]
        if best.merit <= 0.0:
            return

        observer = split.attribute_observers.get(split.split_attribute)
        if observer is None:
            return
        current_gain = gain_of_existing_split(observer, self.num_classes,
                                              split.split_value)
        range_val = math.log2(max(2, self.num_classes))
        epsilon = compute_hoeffding_bound(range_val, self.split_confidence,
                                          split.weight_seen)
        # Mirror the VFDT tie rule: while the bound is loose the improvement has
        # to beat it, once enough examples support the estimate (epsilon below
        # the tie threshold) any material improvement is trusted.
        required = epsilon if epsilon >= self.tie_threshold else self.stale_margin
        if (best.merit - current_gain) <= required:
            return

        # the installed split is no longer the best one -> grow an alternate
        alternate = self._new_leaf(depth=split.depth)
        split.add_alternate(alternate)
        self._seed_alternate(split, alternate)
        split.main_correct = 0.0
        split.main_seen = 0.0
        self.num_alternates_started += 1

    def _test_alternates(self, split: CVFDTSplit,
                         parent: Optional[CVFDTSplit],
                         parent_branch: int) -> Optional[HoeffdingTreeNode]:
        """Promote a winning alternate, prune hopeless ones.

        Returns the promoted subtree root when a replacement happened.
        """
        if not split.alternate_trees:
            return None
        main_seen = split.main_seen
        main_acc = (split.main_correct / main_seen) if main_seen > 0 else 0.0
        best_index = -1
        best_acc = main_acc
        for index in range(len(split.alternate_trees)):
            seen = split.alt_seen[index]
            if seen < self.min_alt_examples:
                continue
            acc = split.alt_correct[index] / seen
            if acc > best_acc:
                best_acc = acc
                best_index = index
        if best_index >= 0:
            return self._promote_alternate(split, best_index, parent,
                                           parent_branch)
        # prune alternates that had enough time and still lose
        for index in range(len(split.alternate_trees) - 1, -1, -1):
            if split.alt_seen[index] >= self.max_alt_examples:
                dropped = split.drop_alternate(index)
                if dropped is not None:
                    self._mark_dead(dropped)
                    self.num_alternates_pruned += 1
        return None

    def _promote_alternate(self, split: CVFDTSplit, index: int,
                           parent: Optional[CVFDTSplit],
                           parent_branch: int) -> HoeffdingTreeNode:
        """Replace ``split``'s subtree by its ``index``-th alternate."""
        alternate = split.drop_alternate(index)
        assert alternate is not None
        self._mark_dead(split)          # kills the old subtree + other alternates
        alternate.alive = True
        self._refresh_depths(alternate, split.depth)
        if parent is None:
            self.root = alternate
        else:
            parent.set_child(parent_branch, alternate)
        self.num_alternates_promoted += 1
        return alternate

    def _mark_dead(self, node: HoeffdingTreeNode):
        stack = [node]
        while stack:
            current = stack.pop()
            current.alive = False
            for child in current.children_nodes():
                stack.append(child)
            for alt in getattr(current, "alternate_trees", ()):  # type: ignore[arg-type]
                stack.append(alt)

    def _refresh_depths(self, node: HoeffdingTreeNode, depth: int):
        stack = [(node, depth)]
        while stack:
            current, current_depth = stack.pop()
            current.depth = current_depth
            current.alive = True
            for child in current.children_nodes():
                stack.append((child, current_depth + 1))
            for alt in getattr(current, "alternate_trees", ()):  # type: ignore[arg-type]
                stack.append((alt, current_depth))

    # -- prediction --------------------------------------------------------
    def _subtree_predict(self, root: HoeffdingTreeNode,
                         instance: Instance) -> int:
        votes = self._subtree_votes(root, instance)
        if not votes:
            return self._prior_class()
        best_class = -1
        best_weight = float("-inf")
        for cls in sorted(votes):
            weight = votes[cls]
            if weight > best_weight:
                best_weight = weight
                best_class = cls
        return best_class if best_class >= 0 else 0

    def _subtree_votes(self, root: HoeffdingTreeNode,
                       instance: Instance) -> Dict[int, float]:
        node = root
        while not node.is_leaf():
            branch = node.branch_for_instance(instance)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
            child = node.get_child(branch)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
            if child is None:
                break
            node = child
        return node.get_class_votes(instance)

    def _prior_class(self) -> int:
        if not self.window_class_counts:
            return 0
        best_class = -1
        best_weight = float("-inf")
        for cls in sorted(self.window_class_counts):
            weight = self.window_class_counts[cls]
            if weight > best_weight:
                best_weight = weight
                best_class = cls
        return best_class if best_class >= 0 else 0

    def get_votes(self, instance: Instance) -> Dict[int, float]:
        votes = self._subtree_votes(self.root, instance)
        if votes:
            return votes
        # a freshly created leaf has no statistics yet: fall back to the
        # class distribution of the current window
        return dict(self.window_class_counts)

    def predict(self, instance: Instance) -> int:
        votes = self.get_votes(instance)
        if not votes:
            return 0
        best_class = -1
        best_weight = float("-inf")
        for cls in sorted(votes):
            weight = votes[cls]
            if weight > best_weight:
                best_weight = weight
                best_class = cls
        return best_class if best_class >= 0 else 0

    def predict_proba(self, instance: Instance) -> Dict[int, float]:
        votes = self.get_votes(instance)
        total = sum(votes.values())
        if total <= 0:
            return {}
        return {cls: w / total for cls, w in votes.items()}

    # -- introspection -----------------------------------------------------
    def get_tree_size(self) -> Dict[str, int]:
        """Return ``{'num_leaves', 'num_splits', 'total_nodes'}`` (main tree)."""
        num_leaves = 0
        num_splits = 0
        total = 0
        stack: List[HoeffdingTreeNode] = [self.root] if self.root is not None else []
        while stack:
            node = stack.pop()
            total += 1
            if node.is_leaf():
                num_leaves += 1
            else:
                num_splits += 1
                stack.extend(node.children_nodes())
        return {"num_leaves": num_leaves, "num_splits": num_splits,
                "total_nodes": total}

    def count_alternates(self) -> int:
        """Number of alternate subtrees currently being grown."""
        count = 0
        stack: List[HoeffdingTreeNode] = [self.root]
        while stack:
            node = stack.pop()
            alternates = getattr(node, "alternate_trees", ())
            count += len(alternates)
            for alt in alternates:
                stack.append(alt)
            stack.extend(node.children_nodes())
        return count

    def get_window_size(self) -> int:
        return len(self.window)

    def get_depth(self) -> int:
        return self.root.subtree_depth() if self.root is not None else 0

    def reset(self):
        self.instances_seen = 0
        self.window.clear()
        self.window_class_counts = {}
        self.num_splits_performed = 0
        self.num_alternates_started = 0
        self.num_alternates_promoted = 0
        self.num_alternates_pruned = 0
        self.num_split_checks = 0
        self.root = self._new_leaf(depth=0)

    def __str__(self) -> str:  # pragma: no cover - debug helper
        size = self.get_tree_size()
        return ("CVFDT(leaves=%d, splits=%d, nodes=%d, alternates=%d, window=%d)"
                % (size["num_leaves"], size["num_splits"], size["total_nodes"],
                   self.count_alternates(), len(self.window)))

def run_cvfdt_experiments(num_instances: int = 100000,
                          window_size: int = 1000) -> Dict[str, float]:
    """CVFDT_DRIFT_ACCURACY / VFDT_DRIFT_ACCURACY on a rotating hyperplane."""
    from evaluation import PrequentialEvaluator
    from streams import RotatingHyperplaneGenerator

    results: Dict[str, float] = {}

    def make_stream():
        return RotatingHyperplaneGenerator(seed=42, num_attributes=10,
                                           num_drift_attributes=5,
                                           drift_magnitude=0.01,
                                           noise_percentage=0.05)

    # --- CVFDT ---
    stream = make_stream()
    cvfdt = CVFDT(num_attributes=stream.num_attributes,
                  num_classes=stream.num_classes,
                  grace_period=300, split_confidence=0.0001,
                  tie_threshold=0.05, window_size=10000,
                  check_frequency=2000, max_depth=20)
    evaluator = PrequentialEvaluator(window_size=window_size)
    for _ in range(num_instances):
        instance = stream.next_instance()
        evaluator.add_result(cvfdt.predict(instance), instance.label)
        cvfdt.train(instance)
    results["CVFDT_DRIFT_ACCURACY"] = evaluator.get_cumulative_accuracy()
    results["CVFDT_DRIFT_WINDOW_ACCURACY"] = evaluator.get_window_accuracy()
    results["CVFDT_TREE_NODES"] = float(cvfdt.get_tree_size()["total_nodes"])
    results["CVFDT_ALTERNATES_STARTED"] = float(cvfdt.num_alternates_started)
    results["CVFDT_ALTERNATES_PROMOTED"] = float(cvfdt.num_alternates_promoted)

    # --- VFDT baseline on the very same stream ---
    stream = make_stream()
    vfdt = HoeffdingTree(num_attributes=stream.num_attributes,
                         num_classes=stream.num_classes,
                         grace_period=200, split_confidence=1e-7,
                         tie_threshold=0.05, max_depth=20)
    evaluator = PrequentialEvaluator(window_size=window_size)
    for _ in range(num_instances):
        instance = stream.next_instance()
        evaluator.add_result(vfdt.predict(instance), instance.label)
        vfdt.train(instance)
    results["VFDT_DRIFT_ACCURACY"] = evaluator.get_cumulative_accuracy()
    results["VFDT_DRIFT_WINDOW_ACCURACY"] = evaluator.get_window_accuracy()
    return results


def main():  # pragma: no cover - script entry point
    results = run_cvfdt_experiments()
    print("CVFDT_DRIFT_ACCURACY: %.4f" % results["CVFDT_DRIFT_ACCURACY"])
    print("VFDT_DRIFT_ACCURACY: %.4f" % results["VFDT_DRIFT_ACCURACY"])

420	        for index in range(len(self.bucket_rows) - 1, -1, -1):

422	                yield bucket

425	                       v0: float = 0.0, v1: float = 0.0) -> bool:
426	        """True when the means of the two sub-windows are significantly apart."""
427	        if n0 <= 0 or n1 <= 0:

430	        return abs(difference) > self.epsilon_cut(n0, n1)

432	    def epsilon_cut(self, n0: float, n1: float) -> float:
433	        """The statistical bound a mean difference has to exceed."""
434	        n = float(self._width)

436	            return float("inf")

438	            # ADWIN2: variance sensitive bound, delta' = delta / (2 ln n)
439	            log_n = math.log(n) if n > math.e else 1.0
440	            delta_prime = math.log(2.0 * log_n / self.delta)
441	            offset = self.min_window_length - 1
442	            inverse_m = (1.0 / max(1.0, n0 - offset)
443	                         + 1.0 / max(1.0, n1 - offset))
444	            variance = self.variance
445	            return (math.sqrt(2.0 * inverse_m * variance * delta_prime)
446	                    + 2.0 / 3.0 * delta_prime * inverse_m)
447	        # Original ADWIN cut: harmonic mean m and delta' = delta / n
448	        inverse_m = 1.0 / n0 + 1.0 / n1
449	        delta_prime = self.delta / n
450	        return math.sqrt(0.5 * inverse_m * math.log(4.0 / delta_prime))

452	    def _check_for_change(self) -> bool:
453	        """Shrink the window while a significant split point exists."""
454	        changed = False
455	        keep_going = True
456	        while keep_going:
457	            keep_going = False
458	            if self._width < 2 * self.min_window_length:
459	                break
460	            n0 = 0.0
461	            u0 = 0.0
462	            v0 = 0.0
463	            n1 = float(self._width)
464	            u1 = self._total
465	            v1 = self._variance_sum
466	            for bucket in self._iterate_buckets_oldest_first():
467	                n2 = float(bucket.count)
468	                u2 = bucket.total
469	                if n2 <= 0:
470	                    continue
471	                rest = n1 - n2
472	                if rest <= 0:
473	                    break               # the newest bucket cannot be cut off
474	                # move the bucket from the newer sub-window to the older one
475	                if n0 > 0:
476	                    mean_diff = u0 / n0 - u2 / n2
477	                    v0 += (bucket.variance
478	                           + n0 * n2 * mean_diff * mean_diff / (n0 + n2))
479	                else:
480	                    v0 += bucket.variance
481	                mean_diff = u2 / n2 - (u1 - u2) / rest
482	                v1 -= bucket.variance + n2 * rest * mean_diff * mean_diff / n1
483	                if v1 < 0.0:
484	                    v1 = 0.0
485	                n0 += n2
486	                u0 += u2
487	                n1 = rest
488	                u1 -= u2
489	                if (n0 >= self.min_window_length
490	                        and n1 >= self.min_window_length
491	                        and self.cut_expression(n0, n1, u0, u1, v0, v1)):
492	                    changed = True
493	                    removed = self._delete_element()
494	                    if removed > 0:
495	                        keep_going = True
496	                    break
497	        if changed:
498	            self._detected_change = True
499	            self.num_detections += 1
500	            self.width_at_last_detection = self._width
501	            self.detection_points.append(self.num_elements)
502	        return changed
503	
504	    # -- helpers -----------------------------------------------------------
505	    def get_window_elements(self) -> List[Bucket]:
506	        """Buckets of the window from oldest to newest (debugging helper)."""
507	        return list(self._iterate_buckets_oldest_first())
508	
509	    def __len__(self) -> int:
510	        return self._width
511	
512	    def __str__(self) -> str:  # pragma: no cover - debug helper
513	        return ("ADWIN(width=%d, mean=%.4f, variance=%.4f, buckets=%d)"
514	                % (self._width, self.get_estimation(), self.variance,
515	                   self.bucket_count))
